description: Finds lines of the EU Combined Nomenclature and TARIC by words (for example "mountain bicycle", "aceite de oliva virgen") or by the first digits of a code (for example "8712"). Returns candidate lines with their 10-digit code, official description and position in the hierarchy. It is a word search over official descriptions, explanatory notes and a vocabulary derived from binding tariff information: it does not classify goods. Covers the EU customs tariff (TARIC) as applied in Spain (mainland and Balearic Islands). Not valid for the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla. For guidance only, not binding.

date.description: Reference date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. From the first date available in the data up to one year ahead.

language.description: Language of the texts returned: Spanish (es), Catalan (ca) or English (en). Official EU texts not published in Catalan are returned in Spanish.

query.description: Words describing the goods (Spanish works best, English is also indexed), or 2 to 10 digits of a code.

name: search_tariff_codes
title: Search tariff codes
